policy: Cited original taxonomic or field research; sources preserve study scale and taxonomic revisions; no specialist approval or AI-style caveat text.

items.label: Romblon frogs reassigned
items.statement: Sibuyan and Tablas populations formerly identified as P. pygmaeus were described as P. guiting in 2026.
items.source: Meneses et al. (2026), Raffles Bulletin of Zoology 74:197–219
items.articleTitle: A new miniaturised Platymantis from Sibuyan and Tablas islands, Philippines
items.scopeLimit: P. guiting from Sibuyan and Tablas replaces earlier P. pygmaeus identifications in those populations.

items.label: Revised island interpretation
items.statement: The 2026 revision separates Romblon Island Group records from Luzon P. pygmaeus.
items.source: Meneses et al. (2026), Raffles Bulletin of Zoology 74:197–219
items.articleTitle: A new miniaturised Platymantis from Sibuyan and Tablas islands, Philippines
items.scopeLimit: P. guiting from Sibuyan and Tablas replaces earlier P. pygmaeus identifications in those populations.

items.label: Sailfin lizard characters
items.statement: The Agusan Marsh treatment describes enlarged toe lamellae and a laterally flattened dorsal sail with serrated edges.
items.articleTitle: An updated herpetological inventory of Agusan Marsh Wildlife Sanctuary
items.scopeLimit: One Agusan River juvenile (SVL 95 mm); specimen size is not the species-wide adult range.

items.label: Agusan riverbank habitat
items.statement: Recorded on overhanging trees beside streams and riverbanks near Agusan Marsh agricultural land.
items.articleTitle: An updated herpetological inventory of Agusan Marsh Wildlife Sanctuary
items.scopeLimit: One Agusan River juvenile (SVL 95 mm); specimen size is not the species-wide adult range.

items.label: Measured juvenile
items.statement: A single juvenile from the Agusan River measured 95 mm snout–vent length.

items.scopeLimit: One Agusan River juvenile (SVL 95 mm); specimen size is not the species-wide adult range.
